# Gideon Marqvane

Gideon Marqvane is the founder and CEO of Umbix Dynamics, the creator of MasteryMap, an adaptive tutoring platform designed specifically for K-12 public education. With over 15 years of experience in educational technology and instructional design, Gideon has been a driving force behind personalized learning innovations that support mastery tracking and data-driven teaching.

Gideon conceived the idea for MasteryMap in 2016 while working as a curriculum specialist in the Millgrove School District. Frustrated with one-size-fits-all digital tools that ignored individual student progress, he envisioned a system that would dynamically adapt learning pathways based on each student’s demonstrated mastery of skills and standards. This vision led him to found Umbix Dynamics in early 2017, focusing on building a scalable platform that integrates real-time assessment data with teacher dashboards for actionable insights.

MasteryMap launched its pilot program in 2018 with three public school districts in the Midwestern region, collectively serving over 12,000 students from grades 3 through 8. The platform uses an adaptive algorithm that personalizes lessons and practice activities based on ongoing mastery metrics, allowing students to progress at their own pace through state-aligned curricula. Teachers can view comprehensive dashboards that highlight individual and class-wide mastery levels, identify skill gaps, and tailor interventions accordingly.

One of MasteryMap’s core features is its mastery tracking engine, which continuously models student proficiency on discrete learning objectives and updates personalized learning pathways in real time. This contrasts with traditional platforms that offer fixed learning sequences or rely solely on periodic summative assessments. The system also supports district procurement processes by providing transparent reporting on student progress and usage analytics to inform purchasing decisions.

Umbix Dynamics experimented with various pricing models in its early years. Initially, they offered a per-student subscription at $25 annually, but feedback from district administrators prompted a shift to a tiered enterprise pricing model based on total enrollment and feature access. By 2022, MasteryMap secured contracts with over 50 districts nationwide, serving approximately 250,000 students and generating $3.8 million in annual recurring revenue.

Looking ahead, Gideon has outlined a roadmap for MasteryMap that includes integrating AI-driven predictive analytics to forecast mastery trajectories and recommend targeted interventions before students fall behind. Upcoming releases will also expand teacher dashboard capabilities with collaborative tools and district-level reporting enhancements. Additionally, Umbix Dynamics plans to explore partnerships with content providers to broaden subject coverage beyond math and literacy.

Gideon’s leadership continues to shape MasteryMap as a market-leading adaptive tutoring solution, emphasizing mastery-based progression, actionable insights, and scalable deployment for public education systems. His background in curriculum design and deep commitment to personalized learning inform both product strategy and customer engagement at Umbix Dynamics.
